name: Navan
description: Navan, formerly TripActions, is an AI-assisted corporate travel booking and expense management platform that combines travel inventory, a corporate card, and automated expense reconciliation in one system.
best_for: Companies wanting travel booking and expense management in one platform, especially organizations under 300 employees that qualify for free travel booking.
pros: Travel booking is free for companies up to 300 employees
24/7 human travel support for booking changes and travel emergencies
SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS Level 1 Service Provider certifications, per Navan's own security page
cons: Expense management is only free for the first 5 users, then billed at $15/user/month
Enterprise pricing and features require a custom sales quote
Published self-serve pricing only covers the Business plan; Enterprise details are not public
features: AI-assisted travel booking (flights, hotels, cars, rail) with automatic enforcement of company spend policy at the point of booking
24/7 human support for booking changes and travel emergencies
AI-driven expense categorization and reconciliation with real-time flagging of policy violations
Navan corporate card, Navan Connect (works with existing Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards), or employee reimbursements
Navan Rewards: redeemable bonuses for employees who book travel below budget
Navan Edge: AI travel assistant for flights, hotels, and restaurant recommendations

pricing.starting_price: Free (Business travel, up to 300 employees); $15/user/month (expense management after 5 free users)

tiers.name: Business - Travel
tiers.notes: Free for companies with up to 300 employees.

tiers.name: Business - Expense Management (additional users)
tiers.notes: Applies once a company exceeds 5 expense-management users.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom quote via sales ("Let's talk" / demo request); for companies above the Business plan's employee threshold or needing enterprise features.

alternatives.name: Ramp
alternatives.description: A spend management platform combining a fee-free corporate card with AI-driven expense, AP, and procurement automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a free corporate card paired with automated expense and accounts-payable workflows.
strengths: Free plan with no annual fees or interest charges on the card
Policy enforcement and price-drop rebooking for travel
Native bidirectional sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct

alternatives.name: Brex
alternatives.description: A corporate card and spend management platform with a free entry tier and AI-driven expense automation.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and scaling companies wanting a free corporate card plus in-app travel booking on one platform.
strengths: Free Essentials plan with travel booking included
AI-powered bill pay and GL coding

alternatives.name: Expensify
alternatives.description: An expense management platform with receipt scanning, a commercial card, and in-app travel booking.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting simple receipt-driven expense reports combined with in-app flight, hotel, car, and rail booking.
strengths: In-app travel booking with automatic expense sync
